title: MV Need Feedback- Mines of Whiteden

posts.author: Jo_Cant_Draw
posts.body:
Hey all!
This is my first time posting here. I have recently gotten RPG Maker MV, and after I watched a few tutorials, I decided to make my first game using the engine: "Mines of Whiteden"
"In the distant land of Whiteden, a mysterious Mineshaft became the center of intrigue, as multiple deaths and dissapearences began occuring. Many heroes and parties came to attempt to solve this problem, but none came back alive. You play as the son of the great hero Thor: A cheeky, smug little man, who is seeking to become the new hero of the land. With his special ability, he will try, try, and try again, making allies and defesting many enemies!"
Its a quick rpg, about an hour long to experience the whole thing, using the assets rpg maker gives. And I was currently looking for some feedback on the game. So I decided to post it here!
Here's the link for the Itch.io page:
https://jo-cant-draw.itch.io/mines-of-whiteden
Do tell me what you think of the game! Any opinions, suggestions, or anything, just tell me! Thank you!
